name: What causes uneven flooring in Bay Area homes?

mainEntity.name: What causes uneven flooring in Bay Area homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Uneven flooring in Bay Area homes can result from several factors. Common culprits include structural settlement over time, especially in older homes, which leads to shifting foundations. Water damage from leaks or floods can warp floorboards and subflooring. Pest infestations like termites can compromise wooden joists and supports. Additionally, poor original construction or inadequate subfloor preparation during installation can contribute to an uneven surface. Identifying the underlying cause is crucial for effective and lasting repair, ensuring the solution addresses the root problem.
acceptedAnswer.description: Uneven flooring in Bay Area homes often results from structural settlement, water damage, pest infestations, or poor original construction.
